moves.label: Trade: Tyrese Haliburton, Buddy Hield, Tristan Thompson, Justin Holiday, Jeremy Lamb and others
moves.description: Tyrese Haliburton, Buddy Hield, Tristan Thompson and a TPE were acquired by the Indiana Pacers from the Sacramento Kings in exchange for: Justin Holiday, Jeremy Lamb, Domantas Sabonis, a conditional 2023 2nd round pick (IND own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Marvin Bagley III, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and others
moves.description: Marvin Bagley III was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick and a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own). Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Serge Ibaka, the draft rights to David Michineau and cash. Serge Ibaka, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Donte DiVincenzo, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman. Donte DiVincenzo, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman, the draft rights to David Michineau, a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: De'Aaron Fox, Jordan McLaughlin, Sidy Cissoko, Zach Collins, Tre Jones and others
moves.description: De'Aaron Fox and Jordan McLaughlin were acquired by the San Antonio Spurs in exchange for Sidy Cissoko, Zach Collins, Tre Jones, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (CHI own), a 2025 2nd round pick (CHI own), a conditional 2023 1st round pick (CHA own), a 2027 1st round pick (SAN own), a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2031 1st round pick (MIN own). Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter, Tre Jones, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (CHI own) and a TPE were acquired by the Chicago Bulls in exchange for Zach LaVine, a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE. Sidy Cissoko, Zach LaVine, a 2025 2nd round pick (CHI own), a conditional 2023 1st round pick (CHA own), a 2027 1st round pick (SAN own), a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own), a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own), a 2031 1st round pick (MIN own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for De'Aaron Fox, Kevin Huerter, Jordan McLaughlin and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Jonas Valanciunas, Sidy Cissoko
moves.description: Jonas Valanciunas and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings from the Washington Wizards in exchange for: Sidy Cissoko, a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own), a 2029 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Jake LaRavia, Colby Jones, Alex Len, Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis and others
moves.description: Jake LaRavia and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Colby Jones, Alex Len and a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own). Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Jake LaRavia, Marcus Smart and a conditional 2025 1st round pick (MEM own). Colby Jones, Alex Len, Marcus Smart, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (MEM own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, Johnny Davis, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: De'Andre Hunter, Keon Ellis, Dario Saric, Dennis Schroder, Keon Ellis and others
moves.description: De'Andre Hunter and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Keon Ellis, Dario Saric, Dennis Schroder and a Least Favorable 2029 2nd round pick. Keon Ellis, Dennis Schroder and a TPE were acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers in exchange for De'Andre Hunter and a 2027 2nd round pick (DEN own). Dario Saric, a 2027 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a Least Favorable 2029 2nd round pick were acquired by the Chicago Bulls in exchange for a TPE.
